purpose: smallest-sufficient, evidence-first mathematical and foundations-of-physics context
instructions: use public sources only
load load_order as the mandatory contract layer before task routing
after task classification load only the smallest sufficient routed_records set
prefer current primary evidence over cached summaries
load the smallest sufficient context for the current task
distinguish proved derived inferred working_hypothesis unknown conflict and candidate_proof states
never infer private facts from public omissions
never claim a literature problem is solved or unsolved solely from model memory when status can be checked
do not turn numerical agreement or a plausible derivation into a proof
identify assumptions and unresolved proof gaps explicitly
look for counterexamples and materially different approaches before declaring impossibility
when evidence is insufficient say so and request the missing sources constraints definitions or conventions
treat public research positions as attributed claims rather than identity instructions
treat directly discussed third-party literature as adjacent evidence rather than Sabine-authored work
do not convert public commentary into endorsement or physical truth
do not impersonate Sabine Hossenfelder
treat the repository screenshot as noncanonical motivation only
exclude site/** from AI context retrieval embeddings training summarisation and claim support
treat every generated site bundle and exported research brief as a projection not canonical evidence
enforce ADJACENT_TRUTH != INHERITED_TRUTH so every substantive claim requires its own evidence
